scheme_name: Go Green Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Go Green Scheme is a significant initiative launched by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board in India. 

This scheme was officially launched on 5th October 2021. 

The primary objective of the Go Green Scheme is to promote environmental sustainability among the workforce in Gujarat. 

It aims to encourage workers to adopt eco-friendly practices in their daily lives. 

The scheme focuses on creating awareness about the importance of a clean and green environment. 

It also aims to enhance the quality of life for laborers by promoting sustainable practices. 

One of the measurable targets of the Go Green Scheme is to plant over 1 million trees across the state of Gujarat by the end of 2025. 

The scheme also aims to educate at least 500,000 workers about environmental conservation by 2024. 

The benefits of the Go Green Scheme include financial assistance for purchasing saplings. 

Workers can receive up to ₹500 for each sapling planted in their vicinity. 

Additionally, the scheme provides training sessions on sustainable practices. 

These training sessions are designed to educate workers on waste management and recycling techniques. 

Eligibility for the Go Green Scheme is primarily focused on laborers registered under the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

Workers must be at least 18 years old to qualify for the benefits of the scheme. 

There is no specific income limit mentioned for eligibility. 

However, it is aimed at workers in the unorganized sector who may not have access to other welfare schemes. 

To apply for the Go Green Scheme, workers must follow a specific application process. 

The first step is to register on the official Gujarat Labour Welfare Board website. 

Applicants need to provide their personal details including name, age, and address. 

They must also submit proof of their employment status. 

This can include documents such as an employment certificate or a registration number with the Labour Welfare Board. 

Once registered, workers can apply for financial assistance for saplings through an online application form. 

The application form requires details about the number of saplings they intend to plant. 

Applicants must also provide a brief plan on how they will care for the saplings. 

The required documents for the application include a valid ID proof, employment certificate, and a photograph. 

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the authorities. 

Approval typically takes around 15 to 30 days. 

Once approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the worker’s bank account. 

The scheme encourages participants to document their planting activities. 

Workers are encouraged to take photographs of the saplings planted. 

These photographs can be submitted as proof of participation in the scheme. 

The Go Green Scheme has a structured timeline for its activities. 

The tree planting initiative is expected to commence in the monsoon season each year. 

This is to ensure better survival rates for the saplings planted. 

The scheme will continue to run annually until the target of 1 million trees is achieved by 2025. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is the primary implementing authority for this scheme. 

The Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Gujarat. 

For any queries or assistance, workers can contact the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board through their official helpline. 

The helpline number is available on their official website. 

The Board also conducts regular workshops and awareness campaigns to promote the scheme. 

These workshops are held in various districts across Gujarat. 

They aim to reach out to as many laborers as possible. 

The Go Green Scheme is part of a larger initiative by the Government of Gujarat to promote sustainable development. 

It aligns with national goals of environmental conservation and climate change mitigation. 

The scheme also contributes to the overall well-being of the labor community. 

By promoting green practices, it enhances the living conditions of workers. 

The Go Green Scheme has received positive feedback from participants. 

Many workers have reported increased awareness about environmental issues. 

They have also expressed a willingness to participate in future green initiatives. 

The scheme is expected to foster a sense of community among workers. 

It encourages collaboration in planting and caring for trees. 

The initiative is also expected to lead to improved air quality in urban areas. 

This is particularly important given the rising pollution levels in cities. 

The Go Green Scheme is a step towards creating a sustainable future for the next generations. 

It empowers workers to take an active role in environmental conservation. 

The scheme is a testament to the commitment of the Gujarat government towards sustainable development. 

Overall, the Go Green Scheme represents a significant effort to integrate environmental consciousness into the lives of laborers. 

It provides them with the tools and resources necessary to contribute positively to their surroundings. 

The initiative is an example of how government schemes can address both social and environmental issues simultaneously. 

By focusing on the labor community, the Go Green Scheme ensures that the benefits of environmental sustainability are inclusive. 

This scheme is a crucial part of Gujarat's broader strategy for sustainable growth and development. 

It highlights the importance of community involvement in achieving environmental goals. 

The Go Green Scheme is poised to make a lasting impact on both the workforce and the environment in Gujarat. 

In conclusion, the Go Green Scheme is a well-structured initiative that combines welfare and environmental sustainability. 

It provides concrete benefits to laborers while promoting a greener future for the state. 

The scheme is an excellent example of how targeted government programs can lead to significant positive changes in society.
